name: iac-authoring
never_do: run Terraform, OpenTofu, or any other tool
access Terraform state, cloud APIs, or cloud credentials
produce apply, import, state, or destroy commands
quote a version number — the pinned versions are in the manifest and the deltas are in facts.json
contradict a settled decision from the compiled ledger
claim the code is verified — only validators verify

purpose: HCL craft for every mission: deployability, connectivity completeness, the syntax rules that make validate fail, and file layout. Cloud and dialect specifics belong to other axes.
